caledonia: From the survey: the two-storey house with its wide course-facing cross gable, the rear wing, the veranda on three sides, four dormers and the chimney.
chaska: From the survey: a tall, steep centre gable between two lower gabled wings, covered walks on posts along the north side and a small south entry gable.
crsc: From the survey: one long hip roof with a deeper, taller centre section, cross gables front and back, the cupola and the chimney.
deacon: From the survey: one long, steep gable crossed by a centre gable, wide shed dormers, low skirt roofs, an open entry porch and the stone chimney.
desertcanyon: From the survey: low crowned and flat roofs behind parapets, with the long dining-patio roof on posts along the course side.
dove: From the survey: three flat-roofed wings around a taller dining room, plus the ramada on the west side.
edinburgh: From the survey: the steep slate great hall with stone cross gables on both fronts, the north and south hip wings with their gable fronts, the flat links and the chimneys.
farmlinks: From the survey: the main gable with a lean-to on the entry side, the glazed sunroom along the course, two lower side wings, three dormers and the chimney.
gnlake: From the survey: the two-storey cross-gabled house with low veranda roofs wrapped round it, terraces at both ends, the cupola and the tall chimney.
interlachen: From the survey: the Tudor complex as it stands, with its long gables, the twin-ridged main hall, the glazed wing set at an angle, the chimney and the terraces.
jewel: From the survey: low hip roofs, with a long cross wing, the two-storey walkout projection facing the course and the hipped entry wing.
legend: From the survey: the curved three-storey lodge built segment by segment around its curve, with gabled peaks on the outer side, the porte-cochère wing, the golf-shop annex and the timber decks.
legends: From the survey: the L-shaped two-storey clubhouse, with the north wing set at its real angle, the clock tower, the cupola, the porch and the stone terrace.
legislator: From the survey: the main hip roof with gabled front wings at both ends, the rear projection, the cupola, the verandas front and back and the raised front terrace.
lehman: From the survey: the long gabled range broken by the pyramid-roofed clock tower, with the taller south wing and the glass-gabled wing turned toward the course at their real angles.
lookout: From the survey: shallow hip roofs over a low one-storey building, with a taller block on the west half and the patio cover along the south side.
maddens: From the survey: a big hip roof crossed by the central cedar gable, with a gablet, four dormers and the chimney.
mystic: From the survey: the two-tier octagonal pavilion with its clerestory and lantern, plus the flat-roofed annex.
northfork: From the survey: the big main gable, the course-side cross gable between two flat-roofed strips, three small gables on the entry side and the tower with its lantern.
orangeburg: From the survey: a long, low-pitched main gable with cross wings both sides, the lantern cupola and the porte-cochère.
pines: From the survey: the Y-shaped plan, three hip-roofed wings meeting at one point, with the two front wings at their real angles.
preserve: From the survey: the long log lodge under its green roof, with a lower east section, a west cross gable, the north wing, the chimney and the screened porch.
prestwick: From the survey: two steep parallel gable wings joined by cross gables, the north entry gable with its open canopy and the raised terrace.
quarry: From the survey: one long, low hip roof with the hipped entry canopy on stone piers.
ridges: From the survey: the two-storey main gable with a full-width north cross gable, the lower south wing, the cupola, shed dormers and the covered upper deck on the course side.
rossbridge: From the survey: the hotel's real size and shape, with its steep slate roofs and cross gables, bell tower, low annexes and raised pool terrace. The round turrets and spires stay on top.
sandvalley: From the survey: the north wing with its cross wing, two tall steep gables, the long south wing and annex, covered porches on posts and two stone chimneys.
santee: From the survey: the main gable in two ridge heights, the gable-fronted end wings, the front porch with its entry gable, the cupola and chimneys.
slmh: From the survey: the tall central roof over a long body with hipped ends, the cross gable with porches at both ends, the cupola and the open verandas.
stoneridge: From the survey: low metal skirt roofs round flat centres, the tall central cross gable, gables at both ends and the open gabled pavilion over the patio.
troy: From the survey: a long gabled range with a taller west section, the hipped cross wing, the east lean-to, two dormers, chimneys and the porte-cochère.
trueblue: From the survey: the steep two-storey roof with three dormers each side, the low veranda roof wrapped all the way round and the tall white chimneys at both ends.
valley: From the survey: the two-storey cross-gabled house with low veranda roofs wrapped round it, terraces at both ends, the cupola and the brick chimney.
wigwam: From the survey: the low pueblo-style building's flat-roofed wings at their real heights, with the open patios and porticos.
wilderness: From the survey: the broad pyramid hip roof with its two lower hip wings.
willingers: From the survey: hip roofs in three heights, the shallow course-side lean-to over the walkout and the hipped entry portico on posts.
windsong: From the survey: the long cedar-shake gable with its north cross wing, two low annexes, the long screened porch along the course and the chimney.
wyboo: From the survey: a cross plan, a gable crossing a longer hipped roof, the lower south wing, the cupola and the raised corner decks.
mammoth: From the survey (the lodge Sand Valley and Mammoth Dunes share): the north wing with its cross wing, two tall steep gables, the long south wing and annex, covered porches on posts and two stone chimneys.
